title: Large deviations of geodesic midpoint fluctuations in last-passage percolation with general i.i.d. weights
key_contribution: Establishes large deviation limits for midpoint transversal fluctuations in general LPP; rate function expressed via shape function

title: Universality of the GOE Tracy-Widom distribution for TASEP with arbitrary particle density
key_contribution: Proves GOE Tracy-Widom universality for TASEP at arbitrary density; relevant for LCS via TASEP connection

title: Large Deviation Principle for Last Passage Percolation Models
key_contribution: Establishes LDP for LPP models at metric level without exact solvability; framework applicable to Bernoulli LPP

title: Modulus of continuity for polymer fluctuations and weight profiles in Poissonian last passage percolation
key_contribution: Identifies exponent pairs (2/3, 1/3) and (1/3, 2/3) for polymer fluctuation and weight profiles in Poissonian LPP
